title: Fix HP UEFI boot loader not found by copying GRUB to Microsoft path
summary: Some HP laptops hard-code the Windows boot path in UEFI, ignoring other boot entries. You can fix this by copying your GRUB EFI file to the Microsoft boot directory on the EFI System Partition.

aliases.text: hp uefi boot loader not found
grub not showing in hp bios
hp laptop boots to windows only
grub не появляется в меню загрузки hp

prerequisites: Access to the EFI System Partition (ESP)

steps.explain: Identify the mount point of your EFI System Partition. It is usually /boot or /efi.
steps.expect: Output shows the device and mount point for the ESP.

steps.explain: Create the Microsoft Boot directory on the ESP. Replace <ESP_MOUNTPOINT> with the path found in the previous step.

placeholders.name: ESP_MOUNTPOINT
placeholders.description: Mount point of the EFI System Partition

steps.explain: Copy the GRUB EFI binary to the hard-coded Windows boot path. This makes the HP UEFI firmware find GRUB when it looks for Windows.

placeholders.name: ESP_MOUNTPOINT
placeholders.description: Mount point of the EFI System Partition

rollback.explain: Remove the copied file to restore the original state.

warnings: This method creates a conflict in dual-boot setups with Windows.
You must repeat this step every time you reinstall or update GRUB.
